name: Hakubaku Organic Soba Noodles (Buckwheat & Wheat Blend)
whyItWorks: Nutty Japanese soba noodles providing soluble rutin bioflavonoids and clean carbs. When boiled tender, they digest cleanly in remission.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Boil for 4–5 minutes in unsalted water. Rinse well under running cold water to wash away starch, then serve chilled or warm in mild dipping broth.
